resources.string: This HEI number is already in use.
Enter a test date between the date of birth and today.
Enter a date breastfeeding stopped between the date of birth and today.
Choose a test the child was eligible to receive.
Select a registered child under 24 months for this follow-up.
The child has not missed a test and cannot be enrolled for follow-up. Next test: %1$s — %2$s.
The child has not missed a test and cannot be enrolled for follow-up.
Advise the caregiver to take the child to a healthcare facility to enroll in HEI services.
Enrolled for follow-up after a positive %1$s test. Refer for confirmatory testing.
Enrolled for follow-up while awaiting the %1$s test result. Follow up at the facility.
Enter the HEI number if the child is registered for HEI services and it was left blank at enrollment.
Negative 18-month result. The child’s follow-up record will close as graduated.
HIV has been confirmed. The child’s record will close as positive and linked to CTC. Make sure the child starts ART.
The child’s record will close as deceased after saving.
The child’s record will close as moved from the area after saving.
The child’s record will close as transferred after saving. HEI services continue at the new facility.
